---
title: "Execution Guides"
subtitle: "Running FACTS and its design engines outside of the FACTS GUI."
title-block-banner: '#125740'
title-block-banner-color: white
---

- [FACTS Command Line](commandLine.qmd): running all the simulations of one or more FACTS project files from the command line, as a batch action.
- [FACTS Trial Execution](trialExecution.qmd): running interim analyses of a trial with the FACTS Core, Platform Trial and Enrichment Design engines from the command line (Trial Execution Mode), and from the "Analysis" tab.
- [Dose Escalation Design Trial Execution](deTrialExecution.qmd): running the Dose Escalation design engine on the current trial data to obtain the recommended dose for the next cohort.
- [FACTS Forward Simulation](forwardSimulation.qmd): running forward simulations with the FACTS Core engines from the command line (Forward Simulation Mode).
